title: Using Maps and Timetables
text:
A map shows the streets and places in a town. You can use a map to find your way. Look at the key to understand the symbols. A map is very helpful for tourists.

A timetable shows when buses and trains leave and arrive. You can look at the timetable to plan your trip. The bus leaves at 8:30 every morning. Check the timetable before you go to the station.

options: The streets and places in a town

questions.text: What time does the bus leave every morning?
Why is a map helpful for tourists?
options: It helps them find their way in a new town
It tells them how to cook food
It shows them the price of hotels
It helps them learn a new language

questions.text: Why should you check the timetable before you go to the station?
options: To know when your bus or train leaves
To buy food at the station
To find the map of the town

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows streets, places and roads
a list that shows when buses or trains leave and arrive
pictures or signs that represent something
a place where trains or buses stop for passengers

paragraph_translations: Um mapa mostra as ruas e os lugares de uma cidade. Você pode usar um mapa para encontrar o caminho. Olhe a legenda para entender os símbolos. Um mapa é muito útil para turistas.
Um horário mostra quando ônibus e trens saem e chegam. Você pode consultar o horário para planejar sua viagem. O ônibus sai às 8h30 todas as manhãs. Verifique o horário antes de ir para a estação.
